slides.texte_overlay:
Man to man, how to rebuild
yourself after a year
that broke you

1. Unfollow what keeps you stuck
The accounts, the group chats,
the old photos. Clean the feed.

2. Build a morning anchor
Same first ten minutes every day.
Coffee, window, no phone.

3. Finish one physical project
Fix the bike. Paint the wall.
Your hands remind your head
you can still build.

4. Say yes to one invitation
Even when you'd rather stay in.
People pull you forward.

5. Spend a weekend outside the city
New air, new view.
Perspective is a place.

6. Learn a skill you've
always put off
Five minutes a day is enough
to start feeling new.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Learn a skill you've
always put off
Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
Five minutes a day.
